metadata.title: Spicy Hot Pork Fry | Naga Recipe
metadata.description:
This is a very delicious and gorgeous looking dish which can be made with minimal ingredients in just under half an hour. The tender juicy pork meat is cooked in its own fat and laced with hot chili flakes and Sichaun Pepper to give it an burst of flavour. 

Ingredients

Pork - 1/2 KG
Kashmiri Chili powder/Paprika Powder - 1 Tbsp
Normal chili powder (coarsely ground_ - 2 Tbsp
Sichaun Pepper - 1 Tbsp
Salt as required
